description: Returns the plan of the organisation of the token: FREE, PAID, PAST_DUE, ENDING or ENDED; watched solutions billed in the current Stripe period, the coming invoice, the payment provider and the invoices. 1 watched solution free, then €0.50 per watched solution per month, €2 monthly minimum (excl. VAT), invoiced by VORAN, paid through Stripe. A paid watch is billed for a period when it is active at least one day of it, whatever the number of agents that read it. Contract 0.4.0. Needs an organisation token (Authorization: Bearer hodds_...); without it the tool returns the error token_required.
name: get_plan

billed.description: Billed in the current Stripe period (€0.50 excl. VAT).

closed_at.description: Day of closing; null while the watch is active.

need.description: The need, cut to 120 characters; null for a CATEGORY watch.

plan.description: FREE: the free watch of the organisation, never billed.

outputSchema.description: Answer of get_plan and GET /api/plan: the plan of the organisation of the token. 1 watched solution free, then €0.50 per watched solution per month, €2 monthly minimum (excl. VAT) while the plan is active, invoiced by VORAN, paid through Stripe. A paid watch is billed for a Stripe period when it is active at least one day of that period, whatever the number of agents that read it. No bank data: card, IBAN and address live at Stripe.

amount_due_estimate.description: max(monthly_minimum, watches_billed × 0.50) for the current period; null outside a paid plan.

billing.description: Name and country of the Stripe customer, as entered at Stripe.

ends_on.description: Last day of the plan when it is ENDING, or PAST_DUE with its stop asked; null otherwise.

minimum_covers.description: Watched solutions covered by the monthly minimum; from the 5th on, €0.50 each.

monthly_minimum.description: S-79: amount excl. VAT due for each Stripe period while the plan is active.

next_invoice.description: End of the current Stripe period and amount_due_estimate; null outside a paid plan.

payment.description: The payment method lives at Stripe; no digit of it is stored or returned.

pending.description: Delivery on the next call: alerts that wait for this organisation. Absent when there is nothing to deliver. Only ack_alerts empties it.

summary.description: One sentence in English, or in French when the request was in French.

plan.description: FREE: one active watch. PAID: watches beyond the free one. PAST_DUE: the last payment failed, watches kept. ENDING: stops at the end of the Stripe period (ends_on). ENDED: stopped; the paid watches were CLOSED.

since.description: First day of the paid plan; null outside PAID, PAST_DUE and ENDING.

summary.description: One sentence in English, or in French when the request was in French (or in the language of the organisation).

watches_billed.description: Paid watches billed in the current Stripe period (active at least one day of it).

watches_total.description: Watches listed in watches[]: the active ones and those closed in the last 30 days.

outputSchema.title: HODDS My ways plan (0.3.2)

title: Read the My ways plan
